claim_one_line: POST HOC data, at the SM seat's ask (its relay section 277): S217's step-2 fit of two free Higgs doublets at the six's strip rerun with the same starts and seeds -- all eight chi2_nine values reproduce exactly (best 2.75 and 4.05) -- and the fitted vectors committed: both doublets lie within about 0.1 of one null line (0, 1, i)/sqrt2, each with its own small e1 admixture (|h.h|/|h|^2 0.010-0.030). Not evidence (two free doublets reach 66% of random CKMs given the six, P-377); the reference for the seat's named-pair test W158. 0 of 19.
